newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Bogawantalawa up 14 pct on tea prices.
newsitem.headline: Bogawantalawa up 14 pct on tea prices.

text.p: Shares in Bogawantalawa Plantations Ltd jumped 13.6 percent or three rupees to 25 on turnover of 10,000 shares in the second session, underpinned by record tea prices, brokers said.
"With tea prices at record highs, local retailers are chasing plantation shares," said one broker.
The six plantation companies trading in Colombo, and companies associated with the sector like Tea Smallholder Factories, are doing well, brokers said.
